title: Personal debts
loadFailed: Could not load debts. Reload the page.
emptyHint: Add a debt to see who owes you and whom you owe.
note: A debt and its repayments change the account balance, never income or expenses.

summary.count: {count, plural, one {# open debt} other {# open debts}}

form.editHint: Repayments change the amount: here you can fix the person, reason, account, due date and note.

originHints.new_movement: Lent or borrowed right now: the account gets a money movement, not income or an expense.
originHints.existing_no_movement: The debt already existed: no money moves, accounts stay as they are.
originHints.purchase_share: The purchase stays a full expense; the other person's share is recorded as a debt owed to you.

form.accountNew: Account the money moves from (or to)
form.dueHint: A due date becomes an obligation in Upcoming and the calendar.
form.purchaseHint: The share is at most the purchase amount.
form.purchaseEmpty: No expenses yet: record the purchase in Operations first.

repay.title: Partial repayment
repay.accountHint: The money goes to (or from) the account. Without an account the repayment is only recorded.
repay.resultDone: The debt will be repaid in full
repay.resultOver: The overpayment of {amount} stays apart from the balance

status.closeBody: {person}'s debt is repaid in full. Mark it closed?
status.writeOffBody: The remaining {remaining} ({person}) will be written off. No money moves, accounts stay as they are.
